expected.fmt:
type Failure:
    case NotFound
    case Denied(reason: String)

fn failure_code(cause: Failure) Int:
    match cause:
        NotFound: return 1
        Denied(_): return 2

fn classify(result: Int!Failure) Int:
    match result:
        error(cause): return failure_code(cause)
        ok(value): return value
